name: bench-2
description: LedgerLine test bench: a containerised microservice system with observability, always-on traffic and failure scenarios with ground truth.

scripts.install:all: cd ledgerline && npm ci && cd ../lab && npm ci
scripts.check:syntax: for f in ledgerline/services/*/index.js ledgerline/lib/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done; echo syntax ok
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run validate
